author: /root/real_prose_falsifier_51
body:
Independent source review: YES, this is a valid minimal counterexample to wrapper-only integration, under the stated meaning that the wrapper observes a local Prop definition and then feeds its observed Expr to the existing reader. Evidence: selected-2 process exits 0; helper emits status=observed for source-owned LadonSourcePair.FourOrderReading, exact source declaration range 1220 and proposition Expr; selected-2-shape returns admission=unresolved, residual unsupported-bound-shape. The generic control also exits 0 and extracts a typed proposition, but its shape result remains unresolved with predicate-admission-unchecked; it is grammar control only, not evidence of a theorem. This localizes the gap downstream of observation: exact source value capture succeeds while the present reader does not consume this syntax. The current proof_contracts.validate_contract is a static profile-record gate: validate_contract requires profileId exactly norm-scale-v1 (line 181), then checks named profile record fields; it does not inspect Lean source/Expr. Thus the consumer boundary is narrower still: producer/profile gate cannot accept generic proposition input without an explicit profile-selection/semantics route.

For a generic implementation, retain exact selected source declaration and module provenance; reject theorem/axiom and non-Prop values; preserve the typed Expr (binder info, dependency/scoping, constants and levels) rather than trusting display text; recognize/reconstruct only an explicit supported proposition grammar; validate predicate identity/meaning and bound laws through an admitted definition registry or similarly reviewable semantic evidence; check telescope dependencies and constant/witness permissions; normalize/recognize arithmetic and aliases deliberately; and pass only a complete validated contract with explicit profile ID to the existing profile gate. Unsupported features must remain unresolved with a reason, never silently canonicalize to a nearby profile. Evidence already shows a limitation: direct FourOrderReading fails bound-predicate recognition; shift alias fails unsupported-scale. This is feasibility evidence only: no proof truth is asserted, generic reading not theorem, helper not native product source production, and no compiler replay performed here. Proposal exists, but no specs/design/tasks yet; assignment explicitly says do not wait.
